ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, if a set of triangular boards are stacked as illustrated, what is the degree measure of $\angle 1$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure,\\
$\because$ $\angle ABD=90^\circ$, $\angle ABC=45^\circ$, $\angle D=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle CDB=\angle ABD-\angle ABC=90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle 1=\angle D+\angle CBD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle 1=60^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{105^\circ}$.
